title: Adaptive Group Robust Ensemble Knowledge Distillation

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring worst-group accuracy (WGA) on subgroups defined by gender in the CelebA dataset (evaluating the spurious correlation between hair color and gender) and the CivilComments dataset (toxicity prediction across male and female subgroups).
Measuring worst-group accuracy (WGA) on toxicity prediction for comments referencing white or black demographic subgroups in the CivilComments dataset.
Measuring worst-group accuracy (WGA) on toxicity prediction for comments referencing LGBT subgroups in the CivilComments dataset.

Measuring worst-group accuracy (WGA) on datasets with environmental or synthetic artifacts to evaluate model reliance on spurious features, such as image backgrounds in the Waterbirds dataset and artificial colors in the Colored MNIST dataset.
